Emma — great, that's exactly the level of detail we needed. Based on the volumes you've shared, below is a concise breakdown and a few options you can consider. I'll have Sales Ops (Laura) turn this into a formal quote once you pick a path.

Summary (hosted API reference pricing and committed-use examples):
- Standard hosted (no commitment): $200 / 1M tokens
- 12-month committed use (tiered by volume): ~30% off -> ~$140 / 1M tokens
- 24-month committed use (tiered): ~40% off -> ~$120 / 1M tokens
- Startup program (YC / accepted startups): startup package includes $25k credits + 40% off for the first 12 months (applies to hosted API) — requires verification

Example math (rounded):
- 10M tokens / month on 12-month committed @ $140/1M => $1,400 / month
- 25M tokens / month on 12-month committed @ $140/1M => $3,500 / month
- 40M tokens / month on 24-month committed @ $120/1M => $4,800 / month

Notes:
- We price embeddings and generation on the same token basis for the hosted tiers; however, for very embedding-heavy workloads we can recommend instance-backed Dedicated pools which can materially reduce unit costs (we can include a Dedicated sizing estimate if you'd like).
- Multi-year incentives (24+ months) typically require a committed spend schedule — if ScoutAI can commit to a $200k+ total spend over 24 months we can escalate for an additional commercial concession (extra % off or onboarding credit).

I've attached the latest pricing sheet and a placeholder committed-use term sheet for ScoutAI to review. Laura — can you prepare a formal quote (line items + SOW) for both 12- and 24-month committed scenarios and the startup discount path?

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_v3.pdf, CommittedUse_Term_Sheet_ScoutAI.docx

Proposed next steps:
- Emma: confirm which committed horizon you prefer (12 vs 24) and whether you'll apply for startup package verification.
- ScoutAI: send any additional procurement fields / PO template (you already sent forms which is helpful).
- Laura: draft quotes + contract (include standard SLA and data residency checkbox).

If you want I can also run a quick forecast showing monthly spend under each ramp scenario.

Best,
